key_insight: A physics-informed neural network infers external pressure that places 99.9% of previously classified unbound molecular clouds into pressure-confined equilibrium.
engineering_relevance: Embedding physical balance laws in neural-network losses can help infer environmental effects missing from isolated-system models.
method: Reassess 2,091 molecular clouds in the Third Galactic Quadrant using a physics-informed neural network.
Embed the complete Eulerian Virial Theorem, including external surface pressure, in the loss function.
Infer a Galactic pressure field that decreases with vertical height and Galactocentric radius.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 99.9% reclassification of previously unbound clouds and a log-log correlation of R = 0.64 between corrected stability and star formation rate.
watch_item: The inferred pressure field needs independent observational validation; the reported correlation alone does not establish causal regulation of star formation.
paper_title: A Physics Informed Neural Network Approach to Decipher Environmental Confinement of Molecular Clouds in the Third Galactic Quadrant
